# GLC library
file(GLOB_RECURSE GLC_SOURCE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/GLC/*/*.cu)
add_library(GLC STATIC ${GLC_SOURCE})
set_property(TARGET GLC PROPERTY CUDA_RESOLVE_DEVICE_SYMBOLS ON)
target_include_directories(GLC PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
set_target_properties(GLC PROPERTIES
    LINKER_LANGUAGE CUDA
    CUDA_SEPARABLE_COMPILATION ON
)

# GLAD
add_library(GLAD STATIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/glad/glad.c)
target_include_directories(GLAD PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

# stb
add_library(stb STATIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/stb/stb_image.cpp)
target_include_directories(stb PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
